normal_success.quote: Success and failure records retain the existing shape and expose the actual attempts count

retryable_failure.quote: Retry only errors whose retryable property is exactly true.

non_retryable.quote: Retry only errors whose retryable property is exactly true.

exhaustion.quote: exhaustion exposes the final error object unchanged.

fifo_fairness.quote: Keep FIFO first attempts; after a failed attempt put a retry at the tail

new_work_not_starved.quote: including work enqueued by the worker

legacy_compatibility.quote: and legacy jobs without a policy

invalid_policy.quote: Invalid maxAttempts must reject with RangeError before that job is enqueued or invoked.
